issue.title: Monitor diagnostics include the synthetic stage-one failure from test_continuation_baseline
issue.description: tests/monitor/test_continuation_baseline.py::test_run_silent_records_failed_stage_and_preserves_early_exit overrides SASE_ARTIFACTS_DIR but inherits SASE_MONITOR_DIAGNOSTICS_DIR from the outer monitored run. tools/run_silent writes to both stores, so the fixture's intentional exit 7 escapes into the real monitor manifest. Fix the fixture environment boundary and add focused regression coverage proving that an outer diagnostics directory remains untouched. No production pager code is involved.

task_type_fields.impact: Follow-up agents receive fake failures ahead of real diagnostics, wasting limited prompt space and directing investigation toward intentional fixture output.
task_type_fields.repro: Run just check or just check-full via sase monitor on HEAD 2e0dd5ee. Monitor k7zjjhbracj7 emitted a failed stage named stage one with exit 7 and body boom although that test passed. The fixture subprocess inherits SASE_MONITOR_DIAGNOSTICS_DIR and redirects only SASE_ARTIFACTS_DIR.
